lesson_intro.heading: Cloud Operations Associate · PM-3.1
lesson_intro.board_text:
Launching EC2 Correctly
Finova · finova-dev · ap-south-1

Why before how:
Bad launches create forever tickets — wrong subnet, open SSH, long-lived keys.

Mental model:
AMI + type + network + IAM role + storage. Keys are last resort.

You will: watch → learn → practice one navigation.
lesson_intro.ren_voice: I am Ren. Bad launches create forever tickets — wrong subnet, open SSH, long-lived keys. Mental model: AMI + type + network + IAM role + storage. Keys are last resort. I demonstrate, then you practice. Least privilege and Region discipline stay non-negotiable.

whiteboard_intro.board_text:
Launching EC2 Correctly
• AMI + type + network + IAM role + storage. Keys are last resort.
• Mistake: Public IP + 0.0.0.0/0 SSH for convenience.
• Habit: Private subnet + Session Manager + instance profile.
whiteboard_intro.ren_voice: Board picture: AMI + type + network + IAM role + storage. Keys are last resort.. Juniors usually: Public IP + 0.0.0.0/0 SSH for convenience.. Your habit: Private subnet + Session Manager + instance profile..

segments.lesson_voice: Launch is a checklist, not a feeling.

check.voice: Name two things you set correctly before launch.
check.response_if_correct: Subnet/network and IAM role — not open SSH as default.
check.response_if_incorrect: Network placement and identity — least privilege access.

steps.voice: A Finova 'quick' bastion with open SSH became a crypto-miner host.
Trap: Public IP + 0.0.0.0/0 SSH for convenience.. Habit: Private subnet + Session Manager + instance profile.
